reason: We wash everything by hand at home and it works fine, so I don't see why we would spend ₹22,000 on a machine now, when every rupee is going toward the wedding. A battery for power cuts doesn't matter to me when we don't own a washer at all.
objection: A normal semi-automatic washer costs about half this, and we have never needed even that one. Taking on ₹2,000 a month in EMI for a year while we are saving would put pressure on the family.
would_change_my_mind: If the wedding were over and someone in the house could no longer hand-wash, and the price came down near a basic semi-automatic, around ₹12,000, I might think about it.
